name: gr-employee-contributions
description: Greek social security contributions (e-EFKA) on employees' pay for 2026: what the employer withholds and what it pays on top. Covers the standard private-sector rates (code KPK 101: employee 13.37%, employer 21.79%, total 35.16%) by branch (main pension, health in kind and in cash, supplementary pension ETEAEP or TEKA, unemployment and other DYPA branches), the 2026 monthly insurable earnings ceiling of EUR 7,761.94, the heavy and unhealthy occupations (BAE) surcharge, occupational risk, bonuses and holiday allowance, the exempt overtime, night and Sunday premiums, the EUR 20 children's camps contribution, the monthly APD return and payment deadlines, board members of an AE, and late-payment interest (ECB refinancing rate plus 8 points). Trigger on: EFKA employer contributions, ασφαλιστικές εισφορές μισθωτών, ΑΠΔ, KPK 101, πλαφόν 2026, εργοδοτική εισφορά, Greek payroll social security.
